Bondi shooting hero remembered one year later

One year after a mass shooting at Sydney's Bondi Junction Westfield shopping center, the courage of a hero who confronted the attacker is being remembered. The incident occurred on April 13, 2023, resulting in six fatalities and multiple injuries. The attacker, identified as Joel Cauchi, was killed by police at the scene. The hero, identified as a former soldier, tackled the attacker, preventing further casualties.
